findings.title: Report unverifiable pins as exit 3
findings.text:
This folds a tri-state `pins_hold` result into a refusal: an `unverifiable` outcome becomes exit 1 ("pins do not
hold") instead of exit 3, contradicting the tool's own three-state contract (`docs/claim-format.md`, AGENTS.md).
Split `fail` (Refused, exit 1) from any non-`pass`/non-`fail` outcome (Unverifiable, exit 3).
findings.existing_code:
if policy.get("outcome") != "pass":
    details = "\n".join(f"  {d}" for d in policy.get("details") or []) or "  (no details)"
    raise Refused(f"the migrated pins do not hold (`pins_hold` is {policy.get('outcome')!r}); "
                  f"re-word the statement or fix the authored slot, never edit a pin to fit "
                  f"the parse:\n{details}")

findings.title: Skip verification for empty migration
findings.text:
When `planned` is empty (e.g. an empty or already-processed `claims/`), this still demands `req` on `PATH` and
runs `canon`/`gate` over an empty scratch corpus, so a true no-op can exit 3 or spuriously refuse. Guard the
verification on `planned` and change the waiver `else` to an explicit `elif not verify:` so an empty verified run
does not print "NOT VERIFIED".
